snippet.title: Blood Bear - Official Trailer - Indie Survival Horror Game
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3800230/Blood_Bear/

Blood Bear is a single player survival horror game. You must get to the bottom of what occurred the night before. Navigate the map, interact, and avoid the park’s residents. Use and upgrade items from around the park in your search for answers.

S U R V I V E

Immersive Experience: Put your survival skills to the test in a highly realistic environment. Maintain hunger and stamina levels with the help of food and drink items from around the park. 

Equipment: Collect a wide variety of items from around the forest to aid you. Use this equipment and even make upgrades, satiate hunger, replenish stamina, and fight off your enemies.

Terrifying Atmosphere: Survival gameplay taken to the next level with frightening visuals, darkly lit environment, and eerie sound design.

Unique Storyline: Interesting storytelling with many cutscenes, enhancing your gameplay and explaining the antagonists motivations. 

Character Interaction: Encounter the game's characters, good and bad, that can either help or hurt your chances of survival.

C U S T O M I Z A B L E     G A M E P L A Y

Non-Linear Map: Explore an extremely detailed, hand crafted world, with each asset intentionally placed in over 20 unique locations. Have the advantage of total control over your exploration. 

Difficulty: Want a tougher challenge? Change the intensity of your survival experience based on your ability. Endless replayability options with the ability to customize the difficulty in many interesting ways.
